categories.main_business_segments: Hangzhou AssureTech Biotech Co., Ltd. primarily focuses on the research, development, production, and sales of POCT (Point of Care Testing) reagents and diagnostic instruments. Its product portfolio covers eight major areas including drug abuse detection, infectious disease detection, chronic disease detection, pregnancy detection, tumor detection, myocardial detection, biochemical detection, and allergen detection. The company also explores new growth areas such as pet health management, home health management, and medical testing laboratories.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages nine core technology platforms including antigen-antibody bio-materials, immunochromatography, dry biochemistry, chemiluminescence, precision detection, liquid biochips, microfluidics, clinical testing instruments, and biopharmaceuticals. It employs advanced manufacturing methods such as microfluidic chip technology, magnetic bead separation, enzyme-catalyzed chemiluminescence, and automated fluorescence immunoassays. The production is characterized by multi-variety, small-batch, and sales-driven manufacturing with a focus on automation and digitalization.
categories.primary_customers_markets: AssureTech serves a global customer base including hospitals, clinical laboratories, pharmacies, law enforcement agencies, and home users. Its products are widely used in clinical diagnostics, forensic testing, food safety, and veterinary diagnostics. The company’s major markets include North America, Europe, Asia, Africa, and Oceania, with over 150 countries and regions covered.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates globally with significant presence in Europe, North America, Asia, Africa, and Oceania. It has established subsidiaries and sales offices in Hong Kong, Singapore, the United States, and multiple cities in China such as Shenzhen and Chengdu. The company actively participates in international medical exhibitions and holds certifications from regulatory bodies in the EU, Canada, Australia, and the US.
categories.supply_chain_position: AssureTech operates across the upstream, midstream, and downstream segments of the POCT supply chain. It has developed capabilities in upstream core biological raw materials including recombinant antigens and monoclonal antibodies, midstream reagent and instrument manufacturing, and downstream sales and service. The company emphasizes self-supply of over 70% of its biological raw materials to reduce dependency and enhance supply chain stability.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes technological innovation and global ecosystem expansion. It invests heavily in R&D across multiple platforms, focusing on upgrading existing products and developing new technologies such as chemiluminescence, molecular diagnostics, liquid biochips, and biopharmaceuticals. Strategic initiatives include expanding product lines, enhancing automation and digital manufacturing, increasing biological raw material self-sufficiency, and deepening international and domestic market penetration.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of POCT diagnostic reagents and instruments. The company employs both ODM (Original Design Manufacturer) and OBM (Own Brand Manufacturer) sales models, catering to brand owners and direct customers respectively. Sales are conducted through domestic and international sales centers, with a significant portion of revenue derived from exports, accounting for over 90% of total sales.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: AssureTech is positioned as one of the few Chinese companies capable of competing with multinational giants in the global POCT market. It holds a competitive edge through its integrated supply chain, advanced technology platforms, and extensive product portfolio. The company is recognized as a national-level specialized and innovative 'Little Giant' enterprise and has received multiple industry awards and certifications, reinforcing its leadership in the domestic and international IVD industry.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 540.7 million, representing a 7.42% increase year-over-year, and a net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 192.3 million, up 35.85%. Total assets stood at RMB 5.77 billion with equity of RMB 5.2 billion. The company maintains a strong R&D investment ratio of about 18.7% of revenue and has demonstrated steady growth and profitability despite industry competition and global economic uncertainties.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: AssureTech emphasizes delivering superior POCT products with high sensitivity, specificity, and stability, supported by self-developed core biological raw materials. Its comprehensive product matrix spans reagents, raw materials, and instruments, enabling integrated solutions. The company differentiates itself through rapid product iteration, advanced technology platforms, global certifications, and a robust global marketing and service network, aiming to provide excellent products and services for human health worldwide.
